name: saas-user-profile
context: Design a user profile and account settings page for a SaaS application. The audience is end-users managing their personal information, avatar, preferences, and security settings. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive. The page must handle form editing, avatar upload, and account danger zone actions.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for section headings and form labels
Apply color.rules.json role assignments for danger zone actions (destructive color tokens)
Use layout.rules.json grid for two-column form layout on desktop
Form inputs must have associated labels and error messages with aria-describedby
All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard operable, visible focus
Avatar upload must provide alt text input and file type restrictions

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with form sections, token references, and interaction states
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Form sections use consistent spacing from Token_System
Danger zone uses destructive color tokens exclusively
Every form input documents valid, invalid, and disabled states
accessibilityRequirements: All form inputs have programmatic labels
Error messages are linked via aria-describedby
Avatar image has meaningful alt text
Focus order follows visual reading order

examples.description: Profile header section with avatar and name display
examples.output:
Organism: ProfileHeader
  Layout: flex(direction: row, gap: var(--space-lg), align: center)
  padding: var(--space-xl)
  Children:
    - Atom: Avatar(size=xl, radius=var(--radius-full), border=var(--border-default))
    - Molecule: UserInfo
        - Atom: Text(role=heading, token=typography.heading.md, color=color.text.primary)
        - Atom: Text(role=subtitle, token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary)
        - Atom: Button(variant=outline, size=sm, label='Edit Profile')
  States: default, editing(border: var(--color-primary))
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all styling
